Subject: Recap + request: VP/CTO intro & next steps

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call:

- Primary use case: customer support summarization and fast retrieval for internal agents (avg doc size ~10k tokens, peak QPS 60)
- Key constraints: sub-200ms P95 latency for short-response routing, enterprise security + SOC 2 evidence, and predictable monthly committed spend for pilot
- Success criteria: 50% reduction in average handle time for support agents and under $0.01 per 1k tokens for typical traffic profile

Next steps I suggested on the call:
1) Exec alignment call (VP/CTO intro) to unblock internal roadmap and procurement — goal is to get your CTO and our VP of Product/CTO aligned on architecture and SLAs
2) Technical deep dive/demo with our solutions engineer to validate latency/cost numbers and walk through a mock integration
3) Procurement/contract cadence conversation once scope is finalized

To move forward on #1, are you available for a 30-min exec alignment call next week? I can do the following windows (PT):
- Tue, Feb 22 — 10:00–10:30 AM PT
- Wed, Feb 23 — 2:00–2:30 PM PT

If those don't work, send a few times that do and I’ll coordinate. I’ve attached a short one-pager of the discovery notes from today (discovery-notes.pdf).

Appreciate it — looking forward to continuing the conversation.

Best,
Marissa Cole
